translations.literal: The court deliberated abolishing the Eastern Campaign Secretariat and establishing a Three Han Secretariat with forms like other provinces; an edict was sent down to the Central Secretariat for mixed discussion; Yue replied: "Goryeo is four thousand li from the capital, its land poor and its people impoverished, its barbarian customs mixed and diverse—not comparable to the Central Plains; if by chance they resisted transformation, to exhaust strength governing them would not be a fortunate affair; better to keep the ancestral old system."
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated abolishing the Eastern Campaign Secretariat and creating a Three Han province like the others, Yue replied, "Goryeo lies four thousand li from the capital, its land is poor and its customs unlike the Central Plains; if it resisted, pacification would exhaust us—better keep the ancestral arrangement."

sentences.zh: 丞相稱善，奏罷議不行。

translations.literal: The Chancellor praised it and memorialized that the proposal be dropped and not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor approved, and the proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 高麗人聞之，圖公像歸，祠而事之，曰：「不絕國祀者，王公也。」

translations.literal: When Goryeo people heard of it they took his portrait home, enshrined and served it, saying: "He who did not cut off our state's sacrifices is Lord Wang."
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo people heard of it, brought his portrait home, and worshipped him, saying, "Lord Wang preserved our state's rites."

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，奉詔廷策天下士，第八剌、張益等八十五人，始增乙科員額至一十五人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding he received an edict to conduct palace examinations of scholars empire-wide; Balha, Zhang Yi, and eighty-five others passed; the quota for the second class was for the first time increased to fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 (1324) he conducted the palace examination; Balha, Zhang Yi, and eighty-five others passed, and the second-class quota was raised to fifteen for the first time.

sentences.zh: 天曆元年，文宗踐祚，約入賀，賜宴大明殿，帝勞問甚歡。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianli, Emperor Wenzong took the throne; Yue entered to congratulate, was granted a feast in the Hall of Great Brightness, and the Emperor consoled and questioned him with great pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1 (1328), when Emperor Wenzong acceded, Yue came to congratulate, was feasted in the Hall of Great Brightness, and received a warm audience.

sentences.zh: 時年七十有七，平居襟度和粹，謙抑自持，後進謁見，必加禮貌；

translations.literal: He was then seventy-seven; in ordinary life his bearing was harmonious and pure, humble and restrained; when younger men came to call he always showed them courtesy;
translations.idiomatic: He was then seventy-seven, of harmonious and humble bearing; junior scholars who called on him always received courtesy;

sentences.zh: 俸祿所入，布散姻族，外及貧士；

translations.literal: his salary income he distributed among kin, and beyond that to poor scholars;
translations.idiomatic: his salary he gave to kin and poor scholars alike;

sentences.zh: 從父居貧，月奉錢米饋餚膳，事之如父；

translations.literal: his father's younger brother lived in poverty; each month he supplied money, grain, and food, serving him as a father;
translations.idiomatic: his uncle lived in poverty, and each month he supplied money, grain, and meals, treating him like a father;

sentences.zh: 歲時朔望，攜子姓至先塋，殿拜懷戀，謹時祭及五祀，動稽古禮，邦人以為矜式。

translations.literal: at the seasons and on the first and fifteenth of each month he led sons and clansmen to the ancestral grave, bowing with lingering affection, carefully performing seasonal sacrifices and the five rites, always consulting ancient ritual—the people of the district took him as a model.
translations.idiomatic: at festivals and on the new and full moon he led his sons and kin to the ancestral graves, observed the seasonal and five rites according to ancient precedent, and the district took him as a model.

sentences.zh: 至順四年二月己酉卒，年八十二，皇太后聞之嗟悼，以尚醖二尊，遣徽政院臣臨吊致奠，敕中書省以下賻贈有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhishun, on the day jiyou of the second month, he died, aged eighty-two; when the Empress Dowager heard she sighed in grief, sent two jars of imperial wine, dispatched a member of the Palace Domestic Service to attend the mourning and offer sacrifice, and ordered the Central Secretariat and below to grant funeral gifts in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He died on the jiyou day of the second month of Zhishun 4 (1333) at eighty-two; the empress dowager grieved, sent two jars of imperial wine, dispatched a Palace Domestic Service officer to mourn him, and ordered graded funeral gifts from the Secretariat down.

sentences.zh: 是月庚申，葬城西岡子原。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen of that month he was buried on Gangzi Plain west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of that month he was buried on Gangzi Plain west of the city.

sentences.zh: 約平生著作，有《史論》三十卷、《高麗志》四卷、《潛丘稿》三十卷，行於世。

translations.literal: Yue's writings in his lifetime included Historical Discourses in thirty juan, Record of Goryeo in four juan, and Drafts from Hidden Mound in thirty juan, circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His writings included Historical Discourses in thirty juan, Record of Goryeo in four juan, and Drafts from Hidden Mound in thirty juan.

sentences.zh: 子思誠，奉議大夫、秘書監著作郎。

translations.literal: His son Sicheng was Grand Master for Discussion and Compiler of the Directorate of Archives.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sicheng was grand master for discussion and compiler in the Directorate of Archives.

sentences.zh: ○王結

translations.literal: ○ Wang Jie
translations.idiomatic: ○ Wang Jie

sentences.zh: 王結，字儀伯，易州定興人。

translations.literal: Wang Jie, styled Yibo, was a man of Dingxing in Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie, whose courtesy name was Yibo, came from Dingxing in Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖逖勤，以質子軍從太祖西征，娶阿魯渾氏，自西域徙戍秦隴，又徙中山，家焉。

translations.literal: His grandfather Diqin, with the hostage army following the Taizu on the western campaign, married a woman of the Arhun clan, moved from the Western Regions to garrison Qin-Long, then moved to Zhongshan, and made his home there.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Diqin followed Taizu west with the hostage army, married a woman of the Arhun clan, moved from the Western Regions to garrison Qin-Long, then to Zhongshan, where the family settled.

sentences.zh: 結生而聰穎，讀書數行俱下，終身不忘。

translations.literal: Jie from birth was clever and perceptive; in reading several lines at once he grasped them and never forgot them his whole life.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was clever from birth, read several lines at a glance, and never forgot what he learned.

sentences.zh: 嘗從太史董樸受經，深於性命道德之蘊，故其措之事業，見之文章，皆悉有所本。

translations.literal: He once studied the classics under Grand Astrologer Dong Pu, deeply versed in the inner meaning of nature, fate, and moral principle; therefore in what he undertook in public service and what appeared in his writings, all had solid foundations.
translations.idiomatic: He studied under Grand Astrologer Dong Pu and mastered the foundations of moral philosophy, so his public service and writings were always grounded.

sentences.zh: 憲使王仁見之，曰「公輔器也。」

translations.literal: Censor Wang Ren saw him and said, "Material for chief minister."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wang Ren saw him and said, "He has the makings of a chief minister."

sentences.zh: 年二十餘，遊京師，上執政書，陳時政八事，曰：立經筵以養君德，行仁政以結民心，育英材以備貢舉，擇守令以正銓衡，敬賢士以厲名節，革冗官以正職制，辨章程以定民志，務農桑以厚民生。

translations.literal: In his twenties he traveled to the capital and submitted a letter to those in power, setting forth eight matters of current policy: establish the classics lecture to nurture the ruler's virtue, practice humane government to bind the people's hearts, cultivate outstanding talent to prepare for examinations, select prefects and magistrates to rectify the balance of appointments, respect worthy scholars to encourage integrity, reform redundant offices to correct the bureaucratic system, clarify regulations to fix the people's aims, and devote effort to farming and sericulture to enrich the people's lives.
translations.idiomatic: In his twenties he went to the capital and memorialized eight reforms: establish the classics lecture, practice humane government, cultivate talent for examinations, choose good local officials, honor the worthy, cut redundant offices, clarify regulations, and promote agriculture.

sentences.zh: 其言剴切純正，皆治國之大經大法，宰相不能盡用之。

translations.literal: His words were incisive, sincere, and pure—all great constants and laws of governing the state; the chancellor could not employ them fully.
translations.idiomatic: His words were incisive and sound, all fundamental principles of statecraft, though the chancellor could not adopt them fully.

sentences.zh: 時仁宗在潛邸，或薦結充宿衛，乃集歷代君臣行事善惡可為鑑戒者，日陳於前，仁宗嘉納焉。

translations.literal: At that time Renzong was in the Hidden Residence; someone recommended Jie to serve in the night guard; he collected deeds of rulers and ministers through the ages, good and bad, that could serve as warnings, and each day presented them before the prince; Renzong praised and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was still heir apparent, Jie was recommended as a night guard; he collected historical examples of good and bad conduct for daily instruction, which Renzong welcomed.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，以仁宗為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Wuzong took the throne he made Renzong Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong acceded he made Renzong crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，命置東宮官屬，以結為典牧太監，階太中大夫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade he was ordered to establish Eastern Palace staff; Jie was made Director of the Imperial Herds, rank Grand Master of Palace Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 (1307) the Eastern Palace staff was established; Jie was made director of the imperial herds with the rank of grand master of palace counsel.

sentences.zh: 近侍以俳優進，結言：「昔唐莊宗好此，卒致禍敗，殿下方育德春宮，視聽宜謹。」

translations.literal: Close attendants presented comic actors; Jie said: "Formerly Tang Zhuangzong loved this and in the end met calamity and ruin; Your Highness is just now cultivating virtue in the Spring Palace—what you see and hear should be careful."
translations.idiomatic: When attendants presented comic actors, Jie said, "Tang Zhuangzong loved such entertainment and came to ruin; Your Highness is cultivating virtue in the Eastern Palace and should be careful what you see and hear."

sentences.zh: 仁宗優納之。

translations.literal: Renzong graciously accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong graciously accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，遷集賢直學士。

translations.literal: When Renzong took the throne, Jie was transferred to Direct Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong took the throne, Jie was made direct academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 出為順德路總管，教民務農興學、孝親弟長、戢奸禁暴，悉登于書，俾朝夕閱習之。

translations.literal: Sent out as Prefect of Shunde Circuit, he taught the people to devote themselves to farming and promote schools, to honor parents and respect elder brothers, to restrain the wicked and forbid violence—all were written in books for daily reading and study.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Shunde Circuit he taught the people to farm, promote schools, honor parents, respect elders, restrain the wicked, and forbid violence, recording all this in books for daily study.

sentences.zh: 屬邑鉅鹿沙河有唐魏徵、宋璟墓，乃祠二公于學，表其言論風旨，以厲多士。

translations.literal: In the subordinate county Julu, on the Sha River, were the tombs of Tang's Wei Zheng and Song Jing; he erected shrines to the two lords at the school, displaying their words and principles to encourage many scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In Julu County on the Sha River stood the tombs of Tang's Wei Zheng and Song Jing; he enshrined the two men at the school and displayed their words and principles to encourage scholars.

sentences.zh: 遷揚州，又遷寧國，以從弟紳僉江東廉訪司事，辭不赴。

translations.literal: Transferred to Yangzhou, then to Ningguo; when his cousin Shen was appointed to the Jiangdong Office for Scrutinizing Governance and Integrity, Jie declined and did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yangzhou and then Ningguo. When his cousin Shen was appointed to the Jiangdong integrity commission, Jie declined and did not take office.

sentences.zh: 改東昌路，境有黃河故道，而會通堤遏其下流，夏月潦水，壞民麥禾。

translations.literal: Reassigned to Dongchang Circuit; within its territory was an old course of the Yellow River, and the Huitong embankment blocked its lower flow; in summer months floodwater ruined the people's wheat and millet.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned to Dongchang Circuit, he found an old Yellow River channel whose lower flow was blocked by the Huitong embankment; summer floods ruined the people's wheat and millet.

sentences.zh: 結疏為斗門以泄之，民獲耕治之利。

translations.literal: Jie memorialized to build sluice gates for drainage, and the people gained the benefit of tillage and cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Jie memorialized for sluice gates to drain the water, and the people gained the benefit of farming again.

sentences.zh: 至治二年，參議中書省事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi he was Participating Secretary for Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 2 (1322) he became participating secretary for Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 時拜住為丞相，結言：「為相之道，當正己以正君，正君以正天下；

translations.literal: At that time Bayiju was chancellor; Jie said: "The way of being chancellor is to rectify oneself in order to rectify the ruler, and rectify the ruler in order to rectify the world;
translations.idiomatic: When Bayiju was chancellor, Jie said, "The way of a chancellor is to rectify oneself to rectify the ruler, and rectify the ruler to rectify the world;

sentences.zh: 除惡不可猶豫，猶豫恐生它變；

translations.literal: in removing evil one must not hesitate—hesitation may give rise to other changes;
translations.idiomatic: in removing evil one must not hesitate, lest worse follow;

sentences.zh: 服用不可奢僭，奢僭則害及於身。」

translations.literal: dress and consumption must not be extravagant or presumptuous—extravagance and presumption bring harm to one's person."
translations.idiomatic: and dress and consumption must not be extravagant, for extravagance brings harm to oneself."

sentences.zh: 丞相是其言。

translations.literal: The chancellor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor agreed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，除吏部尚書，薦名士宋本、韓鏞等十餘人。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Minister of Personnel and recommended more than ten famous scholars including Song Ben and Han Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Minister of Personnel and recommended more than ten scholars including Song Ben and Han Yong.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年春，廷試進士，以結充讀卷官。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Taiding, at the palace examination for jinshi, Jie served as reader of examination papers.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Taiding 1 he served as reader of papers at the jinshi palace examination.

sentences.zh: 遷集賢侍讀學士、中奉大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Attending Reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, rank Grand Master for Court Audience.
translations.idiomatic: He was made attending reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies with the rank of grand master for court audience.

sentences.zh: 會有月食、地震、烈風之異，結昌言於朝曰：「今朝廷君子小人混淆，刑政不明，官賞太濫，故陰陽錯謬。

translations.literal: It happened that there were anomalies of lunar eclipse, earthquake, and violent wind; Jie spoke forthrightly at court: "Now at court gentlemen and petty men are mixed, penal administration is unclear, and official rewards are too lavish—therefore yin and yang are disordered.
translations.idiomatic: When lunar eclipse, earthquake, and violent winds occurred, Jie spoke boldly at court: "Gentlemen and petty men are mixed, justice is unclear, and rewards are too lavish—hence heaven and earth are disordered.

sentences.zh: 咎徵薦臻，宜修政事，以弭天變。」

translations.literal: Ominous signs come repeatedly; government affairs should be repaired to quell heaven's changes."
translations.idiomatic: Warnings keep coming; the government must reform to appease heaven."

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔結知經筵，扈從上都。

translations.literal: That year an edict appointed Jie to direct the classics lecture, and he accompanied the court to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was appointed to direct the classics lecture and accompanied the court to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 結援引古訓，證時政之失，冀帝有所感悟。

translations.literal: Jie cited ancient teachings to prove the errors of current policy, hoping the Emperor would be moved to understanding.
translations.idiomatic: Jie cited ancient teachings to show current policy's failings, hoping to move the emperor.

sentences.zh: 中宮聞之，亦召結等進講，結以故事辭。

translations.literal: The Central Palace heard of it and also summoned Jie and others to lecture; Jie declined on grounds of precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The empress heard of it and summoned him to lecture as well; Jie declined on grounds of precedent.

sentences.zh: 明年，除浙西廉訪使，中途以疾還。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed Commissioner of the Zhe-West Office for Scrutinizing Governance and Integrity, but on the way fell ill and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made commissioner of the Zhe-West integrity office but returned mid-journey because of illness.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，拜遼陽行省參知政事。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was appointed Vice Administrator of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was made vice administrator of the Liaoyang regional secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遼東大水，穀價翔踴，結請於朝，發粟數万石，以賑饑民。

translations.literal: Liaodong suffered great flood; grain prices soared; Jie requested of the court and grain in tens of thousands of shi was issued to relieve the famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: When great floods struck Liaodong and grain prices soared, Jie petitioned the court to issue tens of thousands of shi of grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 召拜刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and made Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 天曆元年，文宗即位，拜陝西行省參知政事，改同知儲慶司事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianli, when Wenzong took the throne, he was appointed Vice Administrator of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, then changed to Associate Director of the Office for Stored Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1, when Wenzong acceded, he was made vice administrator of Shaanxi, then associate director of the Office for Stored Blessings.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜中書參知政事，入謝光天殿，以親老辭，帝曰：「忠孝能兩全乎？」

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Participating Administrator of the Central Secretariat; entering to give thanks in the Hall of Radiant Heaven, he declined on grounds of aged parents; the Emperor said: "Can loyalty and filial piety both be fulfilled?"
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he was made participating administrator of the Secretariat; thanking the emperor in the Hall of Radiant Heaven, he pleaded aged parents; the emperor asked, "Can loyalty and filial piety both be fulfilled?"

sentences.zh: 是時迎立明宗於朔方，明宗命文宗居皇太子位，於是遣大臣奉寶北迓。

translations.literal: At that time Mingzong was welcomed and established in the northern regions; Mingzong ordered Wenzong to occupy the crown prince's position, and great ministers were then dispatched bearing the seal north to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Mingzong was welcomed in the north and ordered Wenzong to remain as crown prince; ministers were sent north with the imperial seal to meet him.

sentences.zh: 近侍有求除拜賞賚者，結曰：「俟天子至議之。」

translations.literal: Close attendants sought appointments, promotions, and rewards; Jie said: "Wait until the Son of Heaven arrives to deliberate."
translations.idiomatic: When attendants sought appointments and rewards, Jie said, "Wait until the emperor arrives to decide."

sentences.zh: 初，上都之變，失皇太子寶，更鑄新寶，近侍請視舊制宜加大，結曰：「此寶當傳儲嗣，不敢逾舊制也。」

translations.literal: Earlier, in the turmoil at the Upper Capital, the crown prince's seal was lost and a new seal was cast; close attendants asked that the old model be consulted and the size increased; Jie said: "This seal should be passed to the heir—one dare not exceed the old system."
translations.idiomatic: After the Upper Capital turmoil the crown prince's seal was lost and a new one cast; attendants wanted it enlarged; Jie said, "This seal passes to the heir—we must not exceed the old standard."

sentences.zh: 或致人於死，而籍其妻孥貲產者，結复論之。

translations.literal: When some caused men to die and registered their wives, children, and property, Jie again argued against it.
translations.idiomatic: When some caused deaths and seized families' property, Jie again objected.

sentences.zh: 近侍益怒，譖詆日甚，遂罷政。

translations.literal: Close attendants grew angrier; slander and abuse increased daily, and he was removed from government.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants grew angrier and slandered him daily until he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 又命為集賢侍讀學士，丁內艱，不起。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to be Attending Reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, but on mourning for his mother he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed attending reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies but did not take office while mourning his mother.

sentences.zh: 元統元年，復除浙西廉訪使，未行，召拜翰林學士、資善大夫、知制誥同修國史，與張起巖、歐陽玄修泰定、天曆兩朝實錄。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuantong he was again appointed Commissioner of the Zhe-West Office for Scrutinizing Governance and Integrity; before he could set out, he was summoned and appointed Hanlin Academician, Grand Master of Virtuous Goodness, Drafter of Edicts and Compiler of National History, joining Zhang Qiyan and Ouyang Xuan in compiling the Veritable Records of the Taiding and Tianli reigns.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuantong 1 (1333) he was again appointed commissioner of the Zhe-West integrity office but, before departing, was summoned as Hanlin academician, grand master of virtuous goodness, drafter of edicts, and compiler of national history, joining Zhang Qiyan and Ouyang Xuan to compile the veritable records of the Taiding and Tianli reigns.

sentences.zh: 拜中書左丞。

translations.literal: He was appointed Left Vice Councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed left vice councillor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 中宮命僧尼於慈福殿作佛事，已而殿災，結言僧尼褻瀆，當坐罪。

translations.literal: The Central Palace ordered monks and nuns to perform Buddhist rites in Cifu Hall; soon the hall burned, and Jie said the monks and nuns had committed sacrilege and should be punished.
translations.idiomatic: The empress ordered monks and nuns to perform Buddhist rites in Cifu Hall; when the hall burned, Jie said the monks and nuns had committed sacrilege and should be punished.

sentences.zh: 左丞相疾革，家人請釋重囚禳之，結極陳其不可。

translations.literal: The Left Chancellor was gravely ill; his family asked to release serious criminals to avert calamity; Jie urgently argued this was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: When the left chancellor was gravely ill, his family asked to release serious criminals to avert calamity; Jie urgently argued that this was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 先時，有罪者，北人則徙廣海，南人則徙遼東，去家萬里，往往道死。

translations.literal: Previously, offenders were exiled—northerners to Guanghai, southerners to Liaodong, ten thousand li from home, and many died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Previously offenders were exiled—northerners to Guanghai and southerners to Liaodong, ten thousand li from home, and many died on the road.

sentences.zh: 結請更其法，移鄉者止千里外，改過聽還其鄉，因著為令。

translations.literal: Jie requested reform of the law: those exiled were sent only beyond a thousand li; if they reformed they were allowed to return to their native place—and this was written as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: Jie requested reform: exiles were sent only beyond a thousand li, and those who reformed were allowed to return home; this was written into statute.

sentences.zh: 職官坐罪者，多從重科，結曰：「古者，刑不上大夫，今貪墨雖多，然士之廉耻，不可以不養也。」

translations.literal: For officials convicted of crimes, heavy penalties were often applied; Jie said: "In antiquity punishment did not reach grandees; though corruption is abundant today, the integrity of scholars must not go unnurtured."
translations.idiomatic: Officials convicted of crimes were often punished severely; Jie said, "In antiquity punishment did not reach grandees; though corruption is rife today, the integrity of scholars must still be nurtured."

sentences.zh: 聞者謂其得體。

translations.literal: Hearers said he had hit the proper tone.
translations.idiomatic: Hearers said he had spoken appropriately.

sentences.zh: 至元元年，詔復入翰林，養疾不能應詔。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan an edict recalled him to the Hanlin Academy, but illness prevented him from answering the summons.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 1 an edict recalled him to the Hanlin Academy, but illness prevented him from answering the summons.

sentences.zh: 二年正月二十八日卒，年六十有二。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the first month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the first month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 結立言制行，皆法古人，故相張珪曰：「王結非聖賢之書不讀，非仁義之言不談。」

translations.literal: Jie in establishing words and regulating conduct all took the ancients as law; therefore Chancellor Zhang Gui said: "Wang Jie reads no books but those of sages and worthies, speaks no words but those of benevolence and righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: Jie's words and conduct followed the ancients; Chancellor Zhang Gui said, "Wang Jie reads only the sages and speaks only of benevolence and righteousness."

sentences.zh: 識者以為名言。

translations.literal: Those with insight regarded it as a famous saying.
translations.idiomatic: Connoisseurs took this as a famous judgment.

sentences.zh: 晚邃於《易》，著《易說》一卷，臨川吳澄讀而善之。

translations.literal: In his later years he mastered the Changes, wrote Exposition of the Changes in one juan, and Wu Cheng of Linchuan read it and approved it.
translations.idiomatic: In later years he mastered the Changes, wrote Exposition of the Changes in one juan, which Wu Cheng of Linchuan praised.

sentences.zh: 及卒，公卿唁於朝，士大夫吊於家，曰：「正人亡矣。」

translations.literal: When he died, dukes and ministers offered condolences at court and scholar-officials mourned at his home, saying: "The upright man is gone."
translations.idiomatic: At his death officials condoled at court and scholars mourned at home, saying, "The upright man is gone."

sentences.zh: 四年五月，詔贈資政大夫、河南江北等處行中書省右丞、護軍，追封太原郡公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year an edict posthumously granted him Grand Master of Governance, Right Chancellor of the Henan and Jiangbei Branch Secretariat, and Defender of the Army, enfeoffed him as Duke of Taiyuan, with posthumous title Wénzhōng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 4 he was posthumously made grand master of governance, right chancellor of the Henan and Jiangbei secretariat, and defender of the army, enfeoffed as Duke of Taiyuan with the posthumous title Wénzhōng (Cultured and Loyal).

sentences.zh: 有詩文十五卷行於世。

translations.literal: He had poetry and prose in fifteen juan circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His poetry and prose in fifteen juan circulated widely.

sentences.zh: ○宋衜

translations.literal: ○ Song Dao
translations.idiomatic: ○ Song Dao

sentences.zh: 宋衜，字弘道，潞州長子人，金兵部員外郎元吉之孫。

translations.literal: Song Dao, styled Hongdao, was a man of Changzi in Lu Prefecture, grandson of Yuan Ji, Vice Director of the Jin Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Song Dao, whose courtesy name was Hongdao, came from Changzi in Lu Prefecture and was grandson of Yuan Ji, vice director of the Jin Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 衜善記誦，年十七，避地襄陽，已而北歸，屏居河內者十有五年。

translations.literal: Dao was skilled at memorization; at seventeen he fled to Xiangyang, then later returned north and lived in seclusion in Henei for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Dao had a remarkable memory; at seventeen he fled to Xiangyang, later returned north, and lived in seclusion in Henei for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 趙璧經略河南，聞其名，禮聘之。

translations.literal: Zhao Bi administered Henan, heard his name, and engaged him with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bi, administering Henan, heard of him and engaged him with full ceremony.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，擢翰林修撰。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong he was promoted to Hanlin Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 3 (1262) he was promoted to Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 李璮畔，璧行中書省事於濟南，至元五年，大兵守襄陽，璧行元帥府事，衜皆從焉，軍事多所諮訪。

translations.literal: When Li Tan rebelled, Bi handled Central Secretariat affairs at Jinan; in the fifth year of Zhiyuan, when the great army held Xiangyang, Bi handled marshal's bureau affairs; Dao followed in all cases, and military affairs were much consulted with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Tan rebelled, Bi handled Secretariat affairs at Jinan; in Zhiyuan 5 (1268), when the main army besieged Xiangyang, Bi ran the marshal's bureau and Dao accompanied him, consulted often on military matters.

sentences.zh: 六年，高麗權臣林衍廢其國王，而立其弟溫，詔遣國王頭輦哥暨璧將兵討之，以衜為行省員外郎，持詔徙江華島居民於平壤。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Goryeo power-holder Im Yon deposed his king and installed his younger brother On; an edict dispatched King T'al-ch'on-go together with Bi to lead troops to punish them; Dao was made Vice Director of the Branch Secretariat, bearing the edict to move residents of Ganghwa Island to Pyongyang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the Goryeo regent Im Yon deposed the king and installed his brother On; T'al-ch'on-go and Bi were sent with troops, and Dao as branch secretariat vice director carried the edict relocating Ganghwa Islanders to Pyongyang.

sentences.zh: 復命，慰勞良厚，仍賜衣段，授河南路總管府判官，不赴。

translations.literal: On returning to report he was consoled and rewarded generously, again granted robes and fabrics, appointed Judge of the Henan Route General Administration, but did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was richly rewarded and offered judge of the Henan route administration, but declined.

sentences.zh: 十三年，入為太常少卿，屬省官制行，兼領籍田署事。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he entered court as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; as the provincial official system was implemented he concurrently directed the Ceremonial Fields Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he became vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and, when the new provincial bureaucracy took effect, also directed the ceremonial fields office.

sentences.zh: 十六年，太子以耆德召見，應對詳雅，大愜睿旨，自是數蒙召問，侍講經幄，開諭為多。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the Crown Prince summoned him for his aged virtue; his replies were detailed and elegant, greatly satisfying the sagely intent; from then on he was repeatedly summoned for questioning, lectured in the classics curtain, and offered much instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 the crown prince summoned him for his learning; his replies pleased the prince, who thereafter called on him often to lecture in the classics curtain.

sentences.zh: 十八年，除秘書監。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Director of Archives.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was made director of archives.

sentences.zh: 十九年，江西分地當署郡邑守令，皆命衜銓舉。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, for the Jiangxi allotment of territory where prefectural and county magistrates were to be appointed, all were ordered selected and recommended by Dao.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he was ordered to select magistrates for the Jiangxi territorial allotment.

sentences.zh: 二十年，初立詹事院，首命衜為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the Heir Apparent's Household was first established, Dao was first appointed Guest of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, when the heir's household was first established, Dao was made the crown prince's guest of honor.

sentences.zh: 每燕見，優賜容接，多所錫賚。

translations.literal: At each informal audience he was graciously received and much bestowed with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: At each audience he was graciously received and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十三年卒，有《秬山集》十卷行於世。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he died; he had the Collected Works of Jushan in ten juan circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 23; his Collected Works of Jushan in ten juan circulated widely.

sentences.zh: ○張伯淳

translations.literal: ○ Zhang Bochun
translations.idiomatic: ○ Zhang Bochun

sentences.zh: 張伯淳，字師道，杭州崇德人。

translations.literal: Zhang Bochun, styled Shidao, was a man of Chongde in Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bochun, whose courtesy name was Shidao, came from Chongde in Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 少舉童子科，以父任銓受迪功郎、淮陰尉，改揚州司戶參軍，尋舉進士，監臨安府都稅院，升觀察推官，除太學錄，入本朝。

translations.literal: In youth he passed the juvenile examination; through his father's office he received appointment as Diligent Merit Gentleman and Huaiyin Assistant Magistrate, changed to Revenue Section Military Attendant of Yangzhou, soon passed the jinshi examination, supervised the Lin'an Metropolitan Tax Office, was promoted to Investigating Judge, appointed Recorder of the Imperial University, and entered this dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he passed the juvenile examination; through his father's office he became diligent merit gentleman and Huaiyin assistant magistrate, then Yangzhou revenue attache; he passed the jinshi, supervised Lin'an's tax office, became investigating judge and imperial university recorder, then entered the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 至元二十三年，授杭州路儒學教授，遷浙東道按察司知事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan he was appointed Professor of the Hangzhou Route Confucian School, then transferred to Director of the Zhedong Circuit Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 23 (1286) he was made professor of the Hangzhou route Confucian school, then director of the Zhedong surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，擢為福建廉訪司知事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was promoted to Director of the Fujian Integrity Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he was promoted to director of the Fujian integrity commission.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，有薦伯淳于帝前者，遣使召問。

translations.literal: After more than a year someone recommended Bochun to the Emperor; an envoy was dispatched to summon and question him.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was recommended to the emperor and summoned for questioning.

sentences.zh: 明年，入見，帝問冗官、風憲、鹽策、楮幣，皆當時大議，所對悉稱旨，命至政事堂，將重用之，固辭，遂授翰林直學士，進階奉訓大夫，謁告以歸。

translations.literal: The following year he entered audience; the Emperor asked about redundant officials, the censorate, salt policy, and paper currency—all great debates of the time; his answers all accorded with the imperial intent; he was ordered to the Secretariat and about to be heavily employed, but firmly declined; he was then appointed Hanlin Direct Academician, advanced to Grand Master for Court Instruction, and took leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was received; asked about redundant officials, the censorate, salt policy, and paper currency, he answered to the emperor's satisfaction; ordered to the Secretariat for heavy employment, he declined and was made Hanlin direct academician with the rank of grand master for court instruction, then took leave to go home.

sentences.zh: 授慶元路總管府治中，行省檄按疑獄衢、秀，皆得其情。

translations.literal: He was appointed Administrative Assistant of the Qingyuan Route General Administration; the branch secretariat ordered him to investigate doubtful cases in Qu and Xiu—all were judged with the true facts.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed administrative assistant of the Qingyuan route administration, he was ordered to investigate doubtful cases in Qu and Xiu and judged them all correctly.

sentences.zh: 大德四年，即家拜翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dade he was appointed at home as Hanlin Attending Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 4 (1300) he was appointed Hanlin attending lecturer while at home.

sentences.zh: 明年，造朝，扈從上都。

translations.literal: The following year he came to court and accompanied the entourage to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he came to court and accompanied the entourage to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 又明年卒。

translations.literal: The year after that he died.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he died.

sentences.zh: 有文集若干卷，藏於家。

translations.literal: He had a collected literary works in several juan kept in his family.
translations.idiomatic: A collected literary works in several juan was kept by his family.
